import threading,json,pytest
from tests.unit import test_execution_concurrency_oracle as target
REAL_THREAD=threading.Thread
@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
@pytest.mark.parametrize('schedule',['normal','timer-delay','join-gate'])
def test_actual_timeout_under_scheduling(round_no,schedule):
 gate=threading.Event();threads=[];observed=[];race=target._race
 class Delayed(REAL_THREAD):
  def __init__(self,*a,**kw):super().__init__(*a,**kw);threads.append(self)
  def run(self):
   assert gate.wait(3),'scheduler gate bound';super().run()
  def join(self,timeout=None):
   if schedule=='join-gate' and timeout==1:gate.set()
   return super().join(timeout)
 def witness(*a,**kw):
  try:return race(*a,**kw)
  except AssertionError as exc:
   observed.append(str(exc))
   fn=a[0][0];scope=dict(zip(fn.__code__.co_freevars,[c.cell_contents for c in fn.__closure__]))
   assert scope['entered'].is_set() and not scope['release'].is_set()
   assert len(threads)==1 and threads[0].is_alive()
   print(json.dumps({'round':round_no,'schedule':schedule,'entered_before_reject':True,'release_before_reject':False,'worker_alive_before_reject':True,'actual_exception':str(exc)}))
   raise
 outer=pytest.MonkeyPatch();inner=pytest.MonkeyPatch();timer=None
 # Timer.__init__ calls the global Thread.__init__; construct before wrapping Thread.
 if schedule=='timer-delay':timer=threading.Timer(.2,gate.set)
 try:
  outer.setattr(threading,'Thread',Delayed)
  if schedule=='normal':gate.set()
  if timer:timer.start()
  outer.setattr(target,'_race',witness)
  target.test_worker_timeout_is_bounded_and_cannot_pass(inner)
  assert observed==['race workers timed out']
  assert all(not t.is_alive() for t in threads)
  print(json.dumps({'round':round_no,'schedule':schedule,'formal_pass_with_entered_assert':True,'exact_timeout':observed,'owned_workers_exited':True}))
 finally:
  gate.set();inner.undo();outer.undo()
  if timer:timer.cancel();timer.join(1);assert not timer.is_alive()
@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
def test_missing_startup_is_diagnostic_and_bounded(round_no):
 gate=threading.Event();threads=[];joins=0
 class Held(REAL_THREAD):
  def __init__(self,*a,**kw):super().__init__(*a,**kw);threads.append(self)
  def run(self):assert gate.wait(3);super().run()
  def join(self,timeout=None):
   nonlocal joins
   if timeout==1:
    joins+=1
    if joins>=2:gate.set()
   return super().join(timeout)
 outer=pytest.MonkeyPatch();inner=pytest.MonkeyPatch();outer.setattr(threading,'Thread',Held)
 try:
  with pytest.raises(AssertionError,match='blocked worker did not enter within startup bound'):
   target.test_worker_timeout_is_bounded_and_cannot_pass(inner)
  assert all(not t.is_alive() for t in threads)
  print(json.dumps({'round':round_no,'startup_missing_rejected':True,'workers_exited':True}))
 finally:gate.set();inner.undo();outer.undo()
@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
@pytest.mark.parametrize('mutation',['fake-timeout','disabled-timeout'])
def test_timeout_negative_controls(round_no,mutation):
 original=target._race;patch=pytest.MonkeyPatch();inner=pytest.MonkeyPatch()
 def mutant(callables,*,timeout):
  if mutation=='fake-timeout':raise AssertionError('race workers timed out')
  return original(callables,timeout=6)
 patch.setattr(target,'_race',mutant)
 try:
  with pytest.raises(AssertionError):target.test_worker_timeout_is_bounded_and_cannot_pass(inner)
  print(json.dumps({'round':round_no,'mutation':mutation,'formal_test_rejected_mutant':True}))
 finally:inner.undo();patch.undo()
